data.subject: Re: Process map for the intake team
data.body:
Hi Priya,

I wanted to follow up on my promise from Sept 2 where I said, "I'll have the process map over to you by the 12th." I see that date has passed and I apologize for the delay. I'm committing to send you the completed process map by Sept 30, 2026. Please let me know if there's anything I can do to help unblock this on your end.

Thanks,
Sam
